source: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ, LDSM_80S_80MPP_ADJ, LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ_1km2 (NASA GSFC PGDA). Barker et al. 2023, Planet. Sci. J. 4, 183, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; data doi:10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole
method: Horizon = ray-marched max terrain elevation angle along 720 azimuths (0.5 deg) from 240 m out to the DEM edge, LOLA 80-90S 80 m/pix DEM (bilinear), observer 2 m above surface. Sun/Earth centre vs horizon, same astronomy-engine method as lunarSky.js. Artemis III region points added 2026-11-14 with the same method (tools/science/terrain_light.py: 80 m map within 29 km, the same map averaged to 320 m beyond); it reproduces the Connecting ridge and Shackleton rim numbers exactly.
